artworks.title: A Stag at Sharkey's
artworks.medium: lithograph in black
artworks.description: This is a print of a boxing match in an arena. Two shirtless boxers are seen grappling in the ring, with a referee nearby. The audience surrounding the ring is shown at the bottom watching the match, some turning to speak to each other. The background is black

artworks.title: The White Hope
artworks.medium: lithograph in black
artworks.description: This is an image of a boxing match. It shows a scene in a boxing ring with one standing boxer and another boxer down on one knee, with a referee checking on him. The crowd around the ring has diverse expressions of tension and excitement. The setting conveys a suspenseful atmosphere. The use of shading and contrast emphasizes the boxers' muscular forms.

artworks.title: Willard in Training Quarters
artworks.medium: lithograph in black
artworks.description: Two muscular men compete in a boxing ring as a crowd looks on from the shadows in this black and white, nearly square lithograph. The fighter on our left stands upright with both arms raised as he tilts his hips backward. The fighter on our right crouches and lunges at his opponent with one arm fully extended toward the first man’s stomach. Both men wear tank tops, shorts, laced shoes, and boxing gloves. The man on our left has dark clothing while the man on our right is brighter. An older, stout man stands with his arms crossed, watching the action from under his eyebrows just on the other side of the boxing ring ropes. The crowd filling the background is nearly lost in shadow but some leering faces emerge from the dark.

artworks.title: Jacques de la Faille
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Herbert and Claiborne Pell
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the knees up, facing slightly to the left. He has a beard, neat short hair, and strong facial features. The man wears an elaborate garment with a high collar, puffed sleeves, a belt with decorations, and a cape. In his left hand, he holds a helmet, and in his right hand, he grasps the hilt of a sword on the ground. The background features armory details, weapons, two smaller figures, and a tent-like structure at the top.

artworks.title: Josina Hamels
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Herbert and Claiborne Pell
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the knees up, standing with her head turned slightly to her left. Her facial features include a high forehead, arched eyebrows, a straight nose, and a neutral expression. Her hair is pulled back into a bun with a headpiece. She wears a formal dress with a high ruff collar, long sleeves with ruffled cuffs, a fitted bodice with buttons and patterned fabric, and slightly puffed sleeves. She rests her right hand on a skull on a table with a book. The background depicts a landscape with figures engaged in various activities near buildings and hills under a cloudy sky. The central image is surrounded by an ornate border with decorative elements and illustrations of music and scholarly themes.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Herbert and Claiborne Pell
artworks.description: The image shows a Renaissance-style sketch featuring four figures seated outdoors. There are three adult figures: a woman holding a small naked infant, a man with distinct cross-hatching across his face and clothing, and another woman holding a small naked child with wings—a cherubim-like figure—who is reaching towards the man. The individuals wear long, flowing robes and sit on a grassy patch surrounded by tall trees under a lightly sketched sky with wispy clouds. In the background, there is a small hill or mountain.

artworks.title: Abraham Francen
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Herbert and Claiborne Pell
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on the right side. He is positioned in a chair, holding a large sheet of paper or canvas with one hand, while the other hand supports part of it. The man has a thoughtful expression, an elongated face, prominent eyes, and a mustache. He has shoulder-length, slightly wavy hair and wears a detailed, patterned garment with a collar and string ties. In the room, there is a small statue on the table next to an open book, and a skull is visible at the edge of the table. The background features an illuminated painting or religious icon on the wall, and a window on the right side reveals foliage outside. The space is dimly lit, with shadows cast by the objects on the tabletop.

artworks.title: Holy Family
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Herbert and Claiborne Pell
artworks.description: The image is a drawing of three figures seated, shown from head to toe. The central figure sits with a relaxed posture, while the figure on their right leans in closely, and the figure on the left holds a book, with their body slightly turned towards the other two. The facial features of the figures are delicately outlined, with detailed, curly hair visible on all three. They are dressed in loosely draped robes that flow around their bodies. The figure on the left appears to engage with the book, while the others are intertwined. In the background, there is a large column and an architectural setting with intricate panel work, which includes a depiction of a statue or relief. The ground beneath the figures is textured with what seems to be grass or foliage.

artworks.title: Two Men at a Gate
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Herbert and Claiborne Pell
artworks.description: The image depicts a wooded landscape with a dirt path curving towards a wooden gate. Two figures are partially visible behind the gate. The horizon is obscured by dense foliage with detailed trees reaching towards the top of the image. The artwork features intricate linework highlighting texture and depth within the scene. The palette is monochromatic, using shades of sepia or black and white, giving a vintage quality. The pathway with grassy edges and a log in the foreground leads the viewer's eye deeper into the scene.

artworks.title: Annie Seated
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Herbert and Claiborne Pell
artworks.description: The image shows a person sitting in a chair, with a slight lean to one side. The person has long hair that is gently parted in the middle and falls over their shoulders. Their face is downcast. They are dressed in a simple, long-sleeved dress. Their hands are resting on their lap. The background is plain, possibly a textured surface.

artworks.title: Little Evelyn
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Herbert and Claiborne Pell
artworks.description: The image depicts a child standing in a relaxed pose, looking straight out. The child has curly hair, gentle facial features, and is dressed in a patterned, long dress. The background includes a simple suggestion of a chair next to the child.

artworks.title: The Fountain
artworks.medium: brown wash over black chalk
artworks.description: The image features a view of a large fountain from slightly below eye level. The horizon is low, revealing a landscape of rolling hills and a single column on the left. The fountain is ornate and dominates the scene, with water cascading down its tiers. A large building with architectural details is in the background to the right. The brushstrokes are loose and there is a monochromatic palette of gray and sepia, creating a soft effect. The composition has a timeless quality, highlighting the interplay of light and shadow on the water's surface.

artworks.title: Lady's Head
artworks.artist: Style of Gabriel Jacques de Saint-Aubin
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length drawing of a woman with delicate features, styled hair, and a soft expression. She is posed with one shoulder raised and her head tilted slightly to the side. She is dressed in a garment with a simple necklace, against a plain, darkened backdrop that contrasts with her lighter tones, emphasizing her figure within the oval frame of the drawing.

artworks.title: Marine
artworks.artist: Style of Willem van de Velde the Younger
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash
artworks.description: The image depicts a naval scene with a fleet of ships at sea. The viewpoint appears to be from a mid to low vantage point. The ships are sailing on the horizon, with their masts and flags visible. There is a large ship on the right with detailed sails and rigging, and smaller boats in the water nearby. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of gray and sepia. The painting technique seems to involve washes and delicate strokes. The scene appears historical and timeless, with a moody atmosphere. In the distance, other ships are arranged in an organized manner. The sky merges with the sea, creating an atmospheric effect.

artworks.title: Marine
artworks.artist: Style of Willem van de Velde the Younger
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene with multiple ships and boats. The horizon is low, while the sky dominates the top part of the image. The style features delicate brushstrokes, likely done with a pencil or ink sketch technique, capturing details of sails and masts. The color palette is mainly monochrome with shades of brown and gray, giving an aged appearance. Small boats with figures are seen nearby on the water, while larger ships with raised sails are in the distance. The background includes more ships, masts, and hulls, indicating a busy port environment.

artworks.title: Marine
artworks.artist: Attributed to Willem van de Velde the Younger
artworks.medium: gray watercolor over touches of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows ships at sea from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is low in the image, with the sea meeting the sky. The ships, mainly large sails and masts, are visible on the horizon, appearing slightly tilted. The brushwork is sketch-like, with fine lines defining the details of the sails and riggings. The color palette is muted and monochrome, with primarily sepia and beige tones and some darker accents. The water reflects the vessels, adding to the calm atmosphere. Faint shapes of other ships can be seen in the background, enhancing depth.

artworks.title: Male Nude Study
artworks.medium: charcoal heightened with white chalk on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in a dynamic pose with his right arm raised upward. He is looking towards his raised hand, with defined facial features and short, curly hair. The man is depicted nude, displaying his muscular physique, and is barefoot on a shadowed surface. The background is neutral, emphasizing the figure's form. There are no accessories, jewelry, or objects in the man's hands.

artworks.title: Male Nude Study
artworks.medium: graphite and black chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.description: This is a full-length drawing of a male figure from the back. The man is standing with his right leg crossed over his left. His left hand is on his hip, and his right arm is extended to rest on a tall block on the right, which he leans on slightly. His face is mostly obscured, although we see his nose and brow in profile as he looks to the left, and he has short, wavy hair. He has pale skin and is nude. The background is plain gray paper, with no other objects except for the block on the right.

artworks.title: Male Nude Study
artworks.medium: black chalk on paper washed gray

artworks.title: Costume Study for "Jeux"
artworks.medium: watercolor, graphite and black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays two full-body sketches of figures placed next to each other on a plain background. On the left is a male figure in a costume with a round neck, short sleeves, and suspenders, wearing shoes and standing with his arms akimbo. A ball is placed at his foot. On the right, there is a female figure in a profile stance with her hands on her hips and a ball resting against her right arm. She is depicted in a knee-length dress with a structured bodice and full skirt, and ballet-style shoes. The background is a light, unadorned shade.

artworks.title: The Grand Canal Looking Toward the Salute and the Dogana
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a Venetian canal with buildings on either side, gondolas and small boats on the water, and a high horizon line made up of rooftops and buildings. The drawing style is detailed with fine lines and gray tones, giving a monochromatic appearance. Light creates contrast and depth, and the color palette is muted, mostly grayscale.

artworks.title: Capriccio of Classical Ruins on a Shore
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink with gray and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with classical architectural ruins, featuring two figures near tall columns. The horizon is low, showcasing distant mountains or hills and more structures. The painting uses delicate brushstrokes in a monochrome color palette of grays and browns, with a sketch-like quality.

artworks.title: Capriccio of Classical Ruins with a Fortress
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with ruins on a hill. The horizon line is low, with ruined structures extending into the distance. Several figures are scattered across the hillside, some engaged in conversation or activity. The ruins show arched windows and partial standing walls. The brushstrokes use monochromatic tones, primarily gray and sepia. The color palette is muted and includes hints of sepia tones. The sky above is softly rendered, allowing the paper texture to show through.

artworks.title: The Island of San Clemente
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite  on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a low vantage point near water, looking across a canal towards an architectural structure with a dome and bell tower in the distance. The horizon is high, with buildings lining it. The sketch is done in ink with fine brushstrokes showing architectural details. The color palette is limited to shades of sepia and brown. Closest are boats on the water, including a gondola with a figure using a pole, and other boats with sails and figures. The background is sparse, focusing on the architecture and water activity.
